# renderdoc_app.h (vendored)

RenderDoc's in-application API header, copied unmodified from the RenderDoc 1.46 Linux tarball
(`include/renderdoc_app.h`). MIT license (see the header). It's designed to be copied into projects: it has
no dependencies, and the library itself (`librenderdoc.so`) is loaded at runtime with `--renderdoc`.
